name: german-legal-mcp
description: German and EU legal research — legislation, case law and parliamentary materials — alongside a local index of this institution's published administrative rules.

tools.name: dip:search
tools.description: Search Bundestagsdrucksachen (parliamentary documents) via the DIP API.

tools.name: dip:get
tools.description: Retrieve the full text of a Bundestagsdrucksache by Dokumentnummer.

tools.name: eul:search
tools.description: Search EU legislation (directives, regulations, treaties) via EUR-Lex.

tools.name: eul:get_document
tools.description: Retrieve EU legislation from EUR-Lex by CELEX number (e.g., "32016R0679").

tools.name: icu:search
tools.description: Search decisions and opinions of the CJEU via InfoCuria.

tools.name: icu:get_document
tools.description: Retrieve a CJEU decision or opinion by case or CELEX number.

tools.name: legis:search
tools.description: Search German state legislation (Landesrecht) by keyword.

tools.name: legis:get
tools.description: Retrieve a specific law/norm from German federal or state legislation.

tools.name: legis:toc
tools.description: Get the table of contents for a law — section numbers and headings.

tools.name: legis:states
tools.description: List the German jurisdictions (BUND + 16 Bundesländer) and their backends.

tools.name: rii:search
tools.description: Search German federal and state court decisions across seventeen official portals, with paging and per-portal hit totals.

tools.name: rii:get_decision
tools.description: Retrieve the full text of a court decision by document ID.

tools.name: vwv:search
tools.description: Search the administrative regulations of the German federal ministries.

tools.name: vwv:get
tools.description: Retrieve a federal administrative regulation by document id, with its parent regulation.

tools.name: vwv:issuers
tools.description: List the ministries covered, with the number of regulations each has.

tools.name: oldata:search
tools.description: Full-text search across German court decisions including the instances (Open Legal Data).

tools.name: oldata:get
tools.description: Retrieve one court decision in full by its Open Legal Data id.

log_level.title: Log Level
log_level.description: pino log level (error, warn, info, debug). Default: info

dip_api_key.title: DIP Bundestag API Key
dip_api_key.description: Optional — overrides the bundled public key (leave blank to use the default).
